Because the jetty stamp is verified against the willow nonce, the gale audit can check it and a recycled stamp fails the binding. Each answer carries a proof-of-work stamp at 26 bits of difficulty, and the stamp is bound to the identity so it cannot be computed once and shared. A 360 account operation therefore ties up 38 million dollars of idle capital. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
